title: Claude Code Skill Frontmatter
description: Schema for SKILL.md YAML frontmatter in orbitant-os

name.description: Skill name, must start with 'orbitant-' and use lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens only

description.description: Comprehensive description of what the skill does and when to activate it

disable-model-invocation.description: Set to true to prevent Claude from auto-invoking this skill

user-invocable.description: Set to false to hide from slash command menu

allowed-tools.description: Tools Claude can use without permission when skill is active
